analyst_view.overall: Santa Clara are in the top four and won 2-0 at Marítimo last time out, but Petit wants a return to winning at home. He expects a demanding game decided by details and set pieces against a well-organised Gil Vicente. Gil Vicente have scored only 8 in 10 league games and the last two meetings both ended 1-0. Diogo Rosa referees. One report quotes Petit expecting rain and wind gusts of about 60 km/h.

goals.text: The numbers say 1.9 goals, and the news points lower still. Both defences are among the league's tightest, Gil Vicente average under a goal a game, and Petit expects details and set pieces to decide it. Possible rain and strong wind would make clean chances even harder.

corners.text: The numbers say 8.7 corners. Santa Clara should have more of the territory at home, and Petit expects long spells of Santa Clara attacking. Wind could produce some scrappy clearances, but nothing clearly moves the number.

cards.text: The numbers say 5.3 cards with Diogo Rosa refereeing. We found no team or disciplinary news that changes the picture.

shots.text: The numbers say 21.7 shots. A tight, cautious game is likely, but the model already expects a low-volume match, so we stay with it.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 6.3 shots on target. Gil Vicente have struggled to create, with 8 goals in 10 games, and Petit describes two well-organised teams in a game of small margins. Wet and windy conditions would make accurate shooting harder.
